examples.english: If you delete and reinstall the app, you'll be asked to redo the initial settings.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) + ⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧ (setting, configuration). Very common in technology and computing contexts, but also used for abstract concepts like goals and plans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再設定|さいせってい}: password reset
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再設定|さいせってい}: resetting goals
- ⟦{初期|しょき}{設定|せってい}→初期設定：09736_shokisettei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再設定|さいせってい}: reconfiguring initial settings
- {再設定|さいせってい}⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: reset screen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リセット→リセット：11199_risetto⟧: reset — the loanword, more casual and often used for physical buttons or figurative fresh starts
- ⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: settings change — modifying rather than starting over
- ⟦{初期化|しょきか}→初期化：09223_shokika⟧: initialization — returning to factory defaults, more drastic than resetting
